SELECT K.PRD_CD, P.PRD_NM, P.SELLER_ID, P.SALE_STAT, K.STK_QTY, K.RSV_QTY, K.STK_QTY - K.RSV_QTY AS AVAIL_QTY, K.SAFE_QTY, CASE WHEN K.STK_QTY - K.RSV_QTY <= K.SAFE_QTY THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SAFE_UNDER_YN, TO_CHAR(K.LAST_IN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LAST_IN_DT, TO_CHAR(K.LAST_OUT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LAST_OUT_DT, TO_CHAR(K.UPD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPD_DT, K.UPD_ID FROM TB_STK K JOIN TB_PRD P ON P.PRD_CD = K.PRD_CD
AND K.PRD_CD LIKE #{PRD_CD} || '%' AND P.PRD_NM LIKE '%' || #{PRD_NM} || '%' AND P.SELLER_ID = #{SELLER_ID} AND K.STK_QTY - K.RSV_QTY <= K.SAFE_QTY
